prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: dedicated panoramic event illustration for the first two warning events of the Warpmoon Project in a Warhammer Fantasy EU4 mod.
Primary request: an enormous Skaven cannon visibly UNDER CONSTRUCTION, before it can fire. The warlock-engineers are building a weapon to shoot down Morrslieb, but here the work is unfinished.
Scene: inside a vast gloomy Skavenblight foundry, an immense horizontal-to-slightly-upward riveted iron and tarnished brass cannon rests on a heavy piston carriage. Part of its barrel is open and incomplete, exposing internal green warpstone focusing coils and missing armor plates. Timber scaffolding surrounds it, chain hoists suspend an unfinished muzzle ring beside the barrel, and tiny hunched ratmen engineers with long tails in ragged russet robes hammer, rivet and guide the assembly from gantries. Low green light from capped warpstone reservoirs and warm orange forge light illuminate smoky cavern architecture. No weapon discharge: there is NO beam, no muzzle flash, no explosion, no impact and no damaged moon. The weapon looks unfinished and inert, not ready to fire. A narrow distant opening can show night sky, but the focus is entirely on the construction.
Composition: extremely wide cinematic panorama suited to a 512x132 event banner, ideal source ratio 128:33, around 2048x528. Keep the essential cannon body, open barrel, suspended ring, workers and scaffolding within a compact horizontal band in the UPPER TWO THIRDS of the canvas if a taller canvas is required, leaving only nonessential dark floor below. Whole main cannon silhouette visible with breathing room horizontally. Arrange machinery and workers at roughly the same height so they survive a shallow banner crop. Clear readable masses at small size.
Style: hand-painted gritty Warhammer dark fantasy illustration, textured oil and gouache brushwork, intricate but coherent mechanical shapes, atmospheric smoke and depth. Matching a previous pair of paintings of a massive rusty brass-and-iron Skaven cannon and a green moon-shot over Skavenblight. Not photorealistic, no shiny CGI.
Palette: dark charcoal, aged bronze, rust brown, muted red robes, restrained luminous emerald warpstone and amber forge light.
Constraints: one continuous scene; no text, no lettering, no logos, no borders, no watermark. No firing, no projectile, no energy beam, no explosion, no shattered moon, no modern industrial cranes, no sci-fi spaceship. Clearly ratmen rather than humans.
